sceneConcept: A watchful twenty-nine-year-old Chinese night driver and late-night radio host stands alone against a transparent background. Her black bob ends at her ears, and tired shadows sit beneath alert brown eyes. A completely plain burnt-orange driver jacket lies open over a black hoodie, dark trousers and practical work shoes, with a small shoulder bag at her side. Unlit broadcast headphones rest around her neck; one hand lightly touches an earcup while the other carries a small handmade grey rabbit cloth doll by its hanging loop, recalling the charm inside her car. Soft even frontal studio light creates no vehicle, road, map, route glow, dizziness effects, radio waves, writing or bright rim. Visual refresh: a compact auditory driving interface behind the ear and a vivid night-driver bomber jacket.
naturalLanguageDetail: A tired but watchful twenty-nine-year-old Chinese night driver and late-radio host wears a plain burnt-orange jacket over a black hoodie with unlit headphones around her neck, lightly touching one earcup while holding a small handmade grey rabbit cloth doll by its loop under soft even frontal studio light with no car, route map, glow, radio waves, writing or bright rim; a compact auditory driving interface behind the ear and a vivid night-driver bomber jacket.
